deals.title: Criterion Collection 50% off at Barnes & Noble (4K UHD included)
deals.detail: All in-stock Criterion discs 50% off online and in stores through Dec. 6, per Criterion. Most 4K titles are $24.99 (from $49.99), including The Princess Bride, Trainspotting, Uncut Gems and Blue Velvet; Seven Samurai and Citizen Kane 4K are $29.99 (from $59.99). Amazon is matching some Criterion 4Ks, such as No Country for Old Men (see below).
